doc.title: Will Shade and Dewey Corley Interview, 1960-05-25

title: Corley's teacher Son Brimmer and his kazoo
summary: Corley says Shade taught him jug; he plays kazoo and piano and demonstrates the kazoo.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: Yeah, well, that's fine. We'll get back to Dewey now. Okay, so you play all those instruments, Dewey, huh?
He's your teacher? That's my background. And what instruments did he teach you?
Oh, he teached me how to play jug, and I know a little bit about piano myself, see? And I got some little kazooks that I blow myself. He didn't learn me that, though.
You got a kazook with you?
Can we hear a little bit of it?
I guess you can. You want to hear some of it?
Say, son. I know that you use mostly your thumb there.
